title: Global Stocks Slump, US Stocks Jump Despite Economic Data Dump

organizations.name: us stocks jump despite economic data dump

text: in General After a week like that, this seemed appropriate...Before we get started, let's note that all is not well in the world (despite the constant happy-talk on 'Murican media)... Global stocks are down 14% from their all-time-high in January... Year-to-Date - Stocks Year-to-Date... US Stocks are dominating..."The Chinese stock market does not reflect the speed of the Chinese economy" is what the mainstream media constantly wants to reassure. There's just one thing... Asia - Mega-tech - TATS - Tencent - Alibaba Asia mega-tech (TATS - Tencent, Alibaba, Taiwan Semi, Samsung) crashed this week...European stocks were all lower too... Course - US - Equities - Dow - S But of course, US equities ended higher... again... The Dow and S&P are no up 6 weeks in a row - because noting else matters. NOTE Nasdaq ended the week lower...US macro data is the most disappointing in 11 months, but stocks love it... Stocks US stocks were on their own...And it was all defensives... TSLA - Bonds FANG Stocks were all ugly too... AAPL - Record - Dollar - Market - Cap But AAPL is soaring to new record highs - holding well above the trillion dollar market cap level...Bonds were bid on the week too... Yields - Week 10Y Yields ended the week unchanged...Another week, another flattening in the yield curve... Bounce - Week - Collapse - EM - FX Despite its bounce - after last week's collapse - EM FX ended the week lower (3rd week in a row)...The Turkish Lira surged over 6%...
